comment: Independent save.c/priest.c witness for forget_temple_entry(): the debug Priest level-teleports to Minetown and arrives in its temple, so the priestess intones and greets him, which sets her intone and entry timers. He level-teleports to level 1 and back; savelev() writes the Minetown monster chain, and save.c savemonchn() makes every priest forget her temple entry. Back on Minetown he reads a wished scroll of magic mapping and teleports beside the altar, and the priestess intones again. I chose seed 4470130 with a JavaScript scan over 4470105-4470139 for a Minetown whose temple has a priest.
